bugs.title: Confirm bug-44..bug-50 fixes are actually live in deployed bots (deploy pipeline verification)
bugs.notes: ROOT CAUSE FOUND & FIXED. Deploy pipeline verification: runs #22-25 (087f927, dc06875, e5a6dcf, e644922) were green and deployed bug-44..bug-47 — those four ARE live. Run #26 (65b7da4, 2026-08-28T09:22, the FIRST deploy run carrying bug-48/49/50 code) FAILED at the 'Run bot test suite' step; both wrangler deploy steps were SKIPPED, so bug-48, bug-49, bug-50 were NEVER deployed. That is exactly why the user saw none of the recent changes. Failing test: 'taskKeyboard exposes only state-valid actions (§8.5)' at bot/test/wizard.test.mjs:142 — assert.ok(!doneFinal.includes('task:next:A')). Mechanism: bug-48 (c8b7be0) re-gated the 'Start next part' button in taskKeyboard on the PLAN's is_final via extractPlanSeries(plan), but taskKeyboard's plan param defaults to null and the §8.5 test calls it with no plan. extractPlanSeries(null) -> is_final undefined, so `planSeries.is_final !== true` was true and the button rendered even when status.series.is_final===true. Real regression vs. the §8.5 state-validity contract, not a flaky test. FIX (1492f90): the button is now hidden when EITHER the plan OR the status reports is_final. Production statuses are normalized by pipeline/status.py to is_final:false, so the plan flag still governs live behavior (bug-48's intent preserved); a status-level is_final:true only further restricts, never wrongly reveals, the action. Verified locally: npm ci + npm test -> 93/93 pass (pre-fix suite fails exactly the way run #26 did). Alternative explanations ruled out: not Telegram keyboard caching and not a wrong bot instance — the deploys genuinely never happened. Pushing this commit (bot/** path) re-triggers 'Deploy Bots — Cloudflare Workers'; next run should go green and ship bug-48/49/50 plus this fix.

bugs.title: Add Instagram publishing support via Zernio (auto Reel + Story on publish)
bugs.notes:
IMPLEMENTED & TESTED. Instagram added as a Zernio publish target across the stack:
(1) pipeline/publish/zernio.py — PLATFORMS now includes instagram; build_platform_payload emits TWO platform entries per Instagram account: a Reel (plain entry — per docs.zernio.com/platforms/instagram a single video without contentType auto-publishes as a Reel) and a Story (contentType="story"). No user content-type selection — every Instagram publish posts both automatically. Media URL source verified: the existing integration never passes user/cloud links — publish_video always uploads the final MP4 via Zernio POST /media/presign and uses the returned direct CDN publicUrl, which satisfies Zernio's Instagram media requirement (docs explicitly say Google Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive/iCloud links do not work as Instagram media URLs).
(2) bot/src/zernio.js — ZERNIO_PLATFORMS + ZERNIO_PLATFORM_LABELS + settings normalization + activeZernioAccounts + targets keyboard all cover instagram; new INSTAGRAM_ACCOUNT_GUIDANCE surfaced on the Zernio settings screen (Business/Creator account required — personal accounts cannot post via the API; auto Reel+Story explained).
(3) bot/src/index.js — targets screen copy, account-refresh confirmation, and dispatch error message updated to mention Instagram and the Business/Creator requirement.
(4) .github/workflows/publish.yml — discover step persists instagram accounts into branding/zernio_accounts.json; validation copy updated.
(5) API shape verified against live docs.zernio.com/platforms/instagram on 2026-08-28: contentType field documented ("Set to story for Stories. Omit otherwise: single videos publish as Reels automatically"); personal accounts cannot post via API (Business or Creator only); cloud-share-link rejection error table confirmed; /media/presign -> uploadUrl -> publicUrl flow matches the existing code.
Tests: bot 93/93 pass; pipeline zernio 87/87 pass. Note: 11 unrelated pre-existing sandbox-env failures in test_cleanup.py/test_stage_b.py (missing OpenCV cascade/YOLO artifacts)/test_status.py — confirmed identical failures on unmodified main via stash round-trip; bot test suite (the deploy gate) is green.

bugs.title: "Push news to clones" not visible to the user — verify gating condition
bugs.notes:
RESOLVED. Root-cause findings (all three hypotheses verified):
(a) STALE DEPLOY — ruled out for current state: bug-46 news feature (bba870e) shipped in deploy run 33158642774 @ 2026-08-28T09:13Z with both wrangler deploy steps green; bug-51 fix deployed in run 33160635806 @ 09:44Z; bug-52 deployed in run 33162451483 @ 10:12Z. The user report window predates the 09:13 deploy — the same broken-deploy window (failed run 33159083660 @ 09:22Z skipping both wrangler steps) that bug-51 documented for bug-48/49/50. So at report time the button genuinely was not deployed; it IS live now.
(b) OWNER-IDENTITY GAP — found and fixed (same class as bug-39/bug-51): validateConnection stored the connected repo slug exactly as the user typed it (${spec.owner}/${spec.name}), while the clone-creation path stored the API-canonical full_name, and all 7 owner gates compared via raw String(repo).toLowerCase() !== originalRepo(env). Any drift (mixed case, surrounding whitespace, a pasted github.com URL, trailing .git) would silently demote the main account to a clone and hide "Push news to clones"/"Publish update to clones". Fix: new bot/src/identity.js exporting originalRepoFromEnv + isOriginalRepo backed by new github.js normalizeRepoSlug (handles case, whitespace, https/git URL forms, .git/trailing slashes); all 7 gate sites in index.js migrated; validateConnection now persists the API-canonical repository.full_name so the stored value always matches the gate.
(c) BUTTON POSITION — verified: single render path only (handleSettingsCallback set:github); the button sits adjacent to "Publish update to clones" under Settings → GitHub clone; no second/stale code path exists.
Tests: bot suite 98/98 pass including 5 new identity.test.mjs regression cases.

bugs.title: Zernio settings still appearing on completed Stage B task view — verify against actual current behavior
bugs.notes:
VERIFIED — no code change warranted; the intended behavior is already live. All three hypotheses checked:
(a) DIFFERENT VIEW: swept every completed-Stage-B-task render path. (1) Main task view taskKeyboard (bot/src/runtime.js:70-100) renders only publish ACTIONS ("📣 Publish (Zernio)" -> showZernioPublishMenu) plus Download/Send video/Refresh/Delete — no settings shortcut. (2) The publish submenu zernioPublishKeyboard (bot/src/zernio.js:320) renders only Publish now/Smart schedule/Choose date and time + per-post retry/reschedule/cancel + back-to-task — no settings button (bug-47 fix intact, comment in code). (3) /done (bot/src/commands/done.js) lists completed tasks with Open/Release/Series-parts rows only. So the only place Zernio CONFIG exists is main Settings → Zernio publishing — exactly what the user asked for.
(b) STALE DEPLOY: bug-47 (ce32973) shipped in deploy run 33158491832 on e644922 @ 2026-08-28T09:15Z — both "Deploy Bot A Worker" and "Deploy Bot B relay Worker" steps succeeded (verified via Actions API). The user re-report predates that green deploy — same broken-deploy window bug-51 documented (failed run 33159083660 @ 09:22Z skipped both deploy steps, so anything checked between the bug-47 code landing and a successful redeploy still showed the old menu).
(c) SECOND RENDER PATH: taskKeyboard has exactly ONE caller (showTask, runtime.js:162). renderInteractiveView edits the active message in place, so a stale PRE-deploy Telegram message in the user's history can still display the retired keyboard until they re-open the task — a display artifact, not a code path. No second renderer exists.
CONCLUSION: current deployed behavior matches the requirement. Reproduction step for the user: re-open the completed task (or tap Refresh) on the live bot — the completed-task view and its publish submenu no longer carry a Zernio settings shortcut.

bugs.title: Series task still stops at complete with no next-part/copy-prompt button — verify against actual current behavior
bugs.notes:
VERIFIED — code fully correct and live; the report is explained by the blocked-deploy window. All three audit questions resolved:
(1) CALLER PASSES PLAN: showTask (bot/src/runtime.js:128-131,162) fetches readProductionPlan alongside readStatus and calls taskKeyboard(status, label, plan) WITH the plan. The next-part gating can fire correctly.
(2) SERIES COPY-PROMPT: implemented — taskKeyboard (runtime.js:81) renders "📋 Copy prompt" (task:prompt:<label>) for completed manual series parts, and sendAgentPrompt (index.js) is series-aware (bug-14: embeds the exact series_id/part/start_seconds so Stage B cross-check passes). This is the same action as task creation but is explicitly wired into the completed-series view, satisfying bug-48's intent.
(3) SERIES-PARTS REVISIT: works — "📚 Series parts" row on the completed task view (runtime.js:94, task:parts handler -> showSeriesParts index.js) AND a "Series parts · <label>" row under each /done entry (commands/done.js:33). Both present and functional.
DEPLOY-FRESHNESS ROOT CAUSE of the user report: bug-48 (c8b7be0) landed the buttons, but the first deploy run carrying bug-48/49/50 (run 33159083660 on 65b7da4 @ 09:22Z) FAILED at the bot test step and SKIPPED both wrangler deploys — so none of it deployed. The features went live only when bug-51's fix shipped green at 09:44Z (run 33160635806 on 4494eec). A user checking between bug-48 landing and the 09:44Z deploy saw no buttons — exactly the reported behavior.
EMPIRICAL PROOF (node, current main): taskKeyboard({state:complete,mode:manual,series:{enabled:true,is_final:false}}, label, plan) renders [📋 Copy prompt][▶ Start next part][📚 Series parts]; with plan.series.is_final:true the next-part button is correctly suppressed; with no plan the buttons still render (status.is_final:false governs). No code change needed.

bugs.title: Deploy-freshness cross-check (Bot A/B deployed version vs origin/main)
bugs.notes:
CROSS-CHECK COMPLETE — deployed Workers are current with origin/main; no ongoing pipeline sync issue. One PAST deploy gap found and already remediated by bug-51.
DEPLOYED vs ORIGIN: latest successful "Deploy Bots" run is 33163301596 @ 2026-08-28T10:25Z on d49a502 (both "Deploy Bot A Worker" and "Deploy Bot B relay Worker" green). Verified via merge-base that d49a502 contains every bot/** commit on origin/main: bug-52 (3992d04), bug-53 (d4adce7), bug-51 (1492f90), bug-50 (42847aa), bug-48 (c8b7be0), bug-47 (ce32973), bug-46 (bba870e). The only origin/main commits AFTER d49a502 are FIX_STATE.json state updates (bug-54/55/56 bookkeeping) — outside the workflow's bot/** path filter, so they correctly do NOT trigger a deploy. No bot code on main is undeployed.
THE ONE GAP THAT EXPLAINS bug-53/54/55: deploy run 33159083660 @ 09:22Z on 65b7da4 — the FIRST run carrying bug-48/49/50 code — FAILED at "Run bot test suite" (taskKeyboard §8.5 state-validity test), so both wrangler deploy steps were SKIPPED. bug-48/49/50 (series-complete buttons, series-toggle removal, etc.) were committed but NEVER deployed until bug-51's fix (1492f90) shipped green at 09:44Z (run 33160635806 on 4494eec). All three user re-reports were filed inside this blocked window (after the code landed, before the 09:44Z deploy) — a single deploy-freshness failure, not three code bugs.
PIPELINE ASSESSMENT: the auto-deploy workflow (deploy-bots.yml) is correctly scoped (push to main, paths bot/**), concurrency-locked (group deploy-bots, no cancel-in-progress), and gated on the bot test suite (npm test) before either deploy step. That test gate is exactly what caught the bug-48 regression and prevented a broken deploy — it worked as designed. No fix to the pipeline itself is required; the failure mode was a code regression, now fixed.
RESIDUAL RISK (informational, not blocking): a failing bot test on a bot/** push silently skips deploys — main can hold undeployed-but-green-on-its-own code if a later commit breaks tests. Mitigation suggestion (not implemented — out of scope): surface failed deploy-bots runs prominently (e.g. repo status check / notification) so a blocked deploy is noticed immediately rather than via user "still broken" reports.
